title: Watch Configurator
alt: A 3D scene of a luxury watch, next to a customization interface
desc: Several immersive experiences for luxury brands, such as Cartier. A watch configurator has also be adapted to an interactive shop front. (see video demo)

title: xArm-6 Viewer
alt: a smooth white robotic arm with multiple articulation
desc:
This model is part of a controller dashboard for an industrial robotic arm with real-time monitoring.
This team project was lead within the De Vinci Innovation Center.

title: History Reconstitution
alt: the medieval building site of a cathedral
desc:
This web player builds 360° scenes of historical places and times.
This work belongs to Histovery, a French agency rewarded in cultural heritage and digital innovation for its cross-reality experiences.

title: 4-Pearl game
alt: A 3D game showing white and black pearls stacked on vertical wood sticks
desc: This project is a digital version of a turn-based boardgame from my childhood. Align four pearls of the same colour along any axis for the win. It features an interactive 3D board and a timeline slider to review game moves.

title: Morse Learner
alt: A desk with a morse key in front of a sunset
desc: This custom project began as a morse interpreter, and became a learning tool in addition to a 3D web experience.

title: Narrative Cutscene Engine
alt: A video game screenshot of a dog in the wilderness with dialog options
desc:
This engine uses a JSON story file to generate an immersive narraitve experience with branching dialog options, sound effects and more. This was a custom project meant to try out AI assisted programming.
See the repository on github

title: Period Tracker
alt: A mockup of a mobile app showing a calendar with menstruation cycles
desc: This minimalist menstruation tracker was made as a 4 days challenge focused on mobile design to try out Tailwindcss and PWA.

title: CH3SS
alt: 3D chess pieces are aligned, floating in a cosmic environment
desc:
This work in progress is a three dimensional, multiplayer chess game.
This is an ongoing custom project, rules and assets are all original based designs.
